reason: I have never heard of this company, and I count every monthly subscription. The free plan is worth a look because I can test it without paying, but I would not pay $19 a month for a company I don't know.
objection: Who is behind this, and will it book the right appointments without my staff having to fix mistakes? I don't want a chatbot making promises to patients in my name.
would_change_my_mind: Reviews or a recommendation from a clinic like mine, plus a few weeks on the free plan showing bookings land correctly in my calendar.
